JOIN ON loan_ledger."SHG Name (as in zoho_books_invoices_export)" = zoho_books_invoices_export."Customer Name" (never on the raw "SHG Name").
-- columns "Apr-25", "May-25", "Jun-25", "Jul-25", "Aug-25", "Sep-25" are months of one measure laid side by side; a blank month means nothing that month, so add them as COALESCE("Apr-25", 0) + COALESCE("May-25", 0) + ... ; to rank months use UNPIVOT "loan_ledger" ON "Apr-25", "May-25", "Jun-25", "Jul-25", "Aug-25", "Sep-25" INTO NAME month VALUE amount.
-- loan_ledger is a running ledger: each row is a movement and "Outstanding Balance" is the balance AFTER that row. The current stock/balance of an item is "Outstanding Balance" on its LATEST row (by date, then row order), not MIN/MAX/SUM over rows.
CREATE TABLE "loan_ledger" (
  "SHG ID" VARCHAR,
  "SHG Name" VARCHAR,
  "Loan Amount Disbursed" BIGINT,
  "Disbursement Date" DATE,
  "Purpose" VARCHAR,
  "Apr-25" DOUBLE,
  "May-25" DOUBLE,
  "Jun-25" DOUBLE,
  "Jul-25" DOUBLE,
  "Aug-25" DOUBLE,
  "Sep-25" DOUBLE,
  "Outstanding Balance" DOUBLE,
  "SHG Name (as in zoho_books_invoices_export)" VARCHAR
);

-- shg_master."shg_name" is the master spelling; zoho_books_invoices_export carries a matching column "Customer Name (as in shg_master)".
CREATE TABLE "shg_master" (
  "shg_id" VARCHAR,
  "shg_name" VARCHAR,
  "village" VARCHAR,
  "block" VARCHAR,
  "date_formed" DATE,
  "bank_name" VARCHAR,
  "bank_account" BIGINT,
  "ifsc" VARCHAR,
  "members" BIGINT,
  "president_name" VARCHAR,
  "president_phone" VARCHAR
);

-- "Customer Name (as in shg_master)" was computed locally: "Customer Name" rewritten in the spelling used by shg_master."shg_name" (approximate match, 142 of 142 values). To combine zoho_books_invoices_export with shg_master: ... JOIN ON zoho_books_invoices_export."Customer Name (as in shg_master)" = shg_master."shg_name" (never on the raw "Customer Name").
-- zoho_books_invoices_export is a running ledger: each row is a movement and "Balance" is the balance AFTER that row. The current stock/balance of an item is "Balance" on its LATEST row (by date, then row order), not MIN/MAX/SUM over rows.
CREATE TABLE "zoho_books_invoices_export" (
  "Invoice Number" VARCHAR,
  "Customer ID" VARCHAR,
  "Customer Name" VARCHAR,
  "Invoice Date" DATE,
  "Due Date" DATE,
  "Status" VARCHAR,
  "Total" DOUBLE,
  "Balance" DOUBLE,
  "Currency Code" VARCHAR,
  "Notes" VARCHAR,
  "Customer Name (as in shg_master)" VARCHAR
);

item.text: The schema says `loan_ledger` is a running ledger where "Outstanding Balance" is the balance *after* each row, and each SHG's stock is the balance on its latest row. Let me check the date range so I can define "as of September".

item.command: /bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 io.py query \"SELECT MIN(\\\"Disbursement Date\\\") AS first_date, MAX(\\\"Disbursement Date\\\") AS last_date, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT \\\"SHG ID\\\") AS shgs FROM loan_ledger\""

/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 io.py query \"SELECT MIN(\\\"Disbursement Date\\\") AS first_date, MAX(\\\"Disbursement Date\\\") AS last_date, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT \\\"SHG ID\\\") AS shgs FROM loan_ledger\""

item.text: The only date column (`Disbursement Date`) ends in June 2025, so "as of September" must come from the month-wide columns. Let me inspect how `Outstanding Balance` relates to those.

item.command: /bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 io.py query \"SELECT \\\"SHG ID\\\", \\\"SHG Name\\\", \\\"Loan Amount Disbursed\\\", \\\"Apr-25\\\", \\\"May-25\\\", \\\"Jun-25\\\", \\\"Jul-25\\\", \\\"Aug-25\\\", \\\"Sep-25\\\", \\\"Outstanding Balance\\\" FROM loan_ledger ORDER BY \\\"SHG ID\\\" LIMIT 5\""

item.text: One row per SHG. I need to understand how "Outstanding Balance" relates to the month columns before choosing the September figure. Checking the balance against month sums.

item.command: /bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 io.py query \"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(\\\"Outstanding Balance\\\" - (COALESCE(\\\"Apr-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"May-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Jun-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Jul-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Aug-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Sep-25\\\",0))) < 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bal_eq_sum_months, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS((\\\"Loan Amount Disbursed\\\" - \\\"Outstanding Balance\\\") - (COALESCE(\\\"Apr-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"May-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Jun-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Jul-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Aug-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Sep-25\\\",0))) < 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bal_eq_disbursed_minus_months FROM loan_ledger\""

/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 io.py query \"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(\\\"Outstanding Balance\\\" - (COALESCE(\\\"Apr-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"May-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Jun-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Jul-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Aug-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Sep-25\\\",0))) < 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bal_eq_sum_months, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS((\\\"Loan Amount Disbursed\\\" - \\\"Outstanding Balance\\\") - (COALESCE(\\\"Apr-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"May-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Jun-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Jul-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Aug-25\\\",0)+COALESCE(\\\"Sep-25\\\",0))) < 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bal_eq_disbursed_minus_months FROM loan_ledger\""
